full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white cinematic photograph centers a woman seated alone at a cafe table in the foreground. She wears a wide dark hat and a simple black sleeveless dress with a square neckline. Pale curled hair is visible beneath the brim. Her left hand supports her cheek while the other arm folds across the table, and she looks directly toward the camera with a quiet, detached expression. A short drinking glass stands near the lower left on a pale patterned tablecloth. Behind her, several men in white shirts and dark jackets sit and stand at a counter. One bald man at the left looks toward the camera; another silver-haired man turns in profile at the right, partly blocking the dark room. Additional faces and bright fixtures recede into the upper background. The foreground woman is the clearest and most evenly lit figure, her pale face framed by the black hat and dress. Strong contrasts shape the scene: white shirts and skin emerge sharply from dark wood, while the tablecloth forms a light base beneath the crossed arms. The lighting appears to come from above and slightly in front, creating soft facial modeling and deeper shade under the hat brim. Fine film grain and slightly blurred background detail make the busy interior feel immediate rather than staged. The composition holds a still person against social movement, using the near-centered hat, resting hand and triangular arms to anchor a crowded field of faces. The entire frame feels observant and tense, with ordinary cafe detail turned into a dramatic monochrome moment.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白电影摄影把一名独坐咖啡馆桌旁的女子放在前景中央。她戴宽大深帽，穿方领黑色无袖连衣裙。帽檐下露出浅色卷发。她左手托住脸颊，另一只手臂折放在桌上，直接望向镜头，神情安静而疏离。左下方一只矮玻璃杯立在浅色花纹桌布上。她身后，几名穿白衬衫和深外套的男子坐或站在吧台旁。左边一名秃发男子望向镜头，右边另一名银发男子转成侧影，部分挡住暗房间。更多脸和明亮灯具向上方背景退远。前景女子最清晰，受光也最均匀，浅面孔被黑帽与黑裙框住。强烈对比塑造场景：白衬衫和皮肤从深木色里鲜明出现，桌布则在交叉手臂下形成浅色基底。光似乎从上方偏前来到，脸部塑形柔和，帽檐下阴影更深。细电影颗粒和略模糊的背景细节让繁忙室内显得即时，而非刻意摆拍。构图让一名静止的人对着社交活动，以近乎居中的帽子、托腮手势和三角形手臂，固定充满人脸的色域。整幅画面观察感强又有张力，寻常咖啡馆细节变成戏剧化的黑白瞬间。
style_prompt_en: The image has a black-and-white cinematic photographic surface with fine grain and strong but controlled tonal contrast. Pale faces, cloth and small highlights emerge from broad dark areas, creating a clear center amid layered background activity. The near focal form is sharply resolved, while receding figures and fixtures soften gradually. Light falls from above and slightly forward, modeling curved surfaces gently but leaving pronounced shade below overhangs and between crowded shapes. A light horizontal base balances a dark rounded upper mass, with diagonal and triangular near forms organizing the middle. The frame is closely cropped and populated at several depths, yet a single calm focal point holds it together. Edges remain crisp in the foreground and become less certain deeper in the scene. The material feels like a mid-century film still: textured, immediate and observant. Its dramatic effect comes from poised stillness, social density and a measured distribution of white against near-black.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有黑白电影摄影表面，细颗粒与强而受控的明暗对比并存。浅色面孔、布面和小亮点从宽阔暗区里出现，在层叠背景活动中形成清楚中心。近处焦点形体解析锐利，退远的人物和灯具逐步柔化。光从上方略靠前落下，温和塑造曲面，又在突出部分下和拥挤形状之间留有明显阴影。一道浅色水平基底平衡上方深色圆形团块，斜线与三角形近处形体组织中部。画面裁切紧密，在多个纵深层有形体，却仍由单一平静焦点稳住。前景边缘清楚，深处界线渐不确定。材质像二十世纪中期电影剧照：有肌理、即时且带观察感。戏剧效果来自从容的静止、社交密度及白色与近黑色的有度分配。
theme_en: A woman in a black hat rests her chin on one hand at a crowded cafe table in monochrome light
theme_zh: 一名戴黑帽的女子在拥挤咖啡馆桌旁以手托腮，置身黑白光影中
name: Billy Wilder
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
